Assistant ProfessorCoordinator (BCom 2nd Year)BBM, M.Com, Ph.D. (University of Mysore, Manasagangotri) Linkedin Link Dr. Vinaya T is an academician with 17 years of experience that spans both teaching and corporate domains. Specialised in finance, accounting, taxation and research, he brings a unique blend of theoretical knowledge and practical insights into the classroom. Known for his student-centric approach, he takes pride in mentoring and resolving student concerns effectively. Dr. Vinaya embraces an unconventional yet engaging teaching style that emphasises the real-world application of academic concepts, encouraging his students to view topics from multiple perspectives.
